summary: This note is a short biography of Suzanne Legrand, a French actress, musical theater performer and writer. It says her career began on French television in a series where she played the youngest daughter, and that she has since worked in TV series, films, theater and musicals in France and the US. It highlights her award-winning performance in La pisseuse ("Desperate"), which she also wrote and directed with Frederic Benzaquen.
one_line: French actress, musical theater performer and writer known for TV, film, theater and the award-winning La pisseuse.
key_facts: Suzanne Legrand is a French actress, musical theater performer and writer.
Her career started on French TV with a series in which she played the youngest daughter.
Since her TV debut she has played in many television series, movies, theater plays and musicals.
Her work has been in France and in the US.
Suzanne Legrand has received several awards at international film festivals.
The awards were for her performance in La pisseuse ("Desperate").
Suzanne Legrand directed La pisseuse ("Desperate") with Frederic Benzaquen.
The note does not name the TV series in which she made her debut.
